data.label: Bayananku
data.export_where: Duk bayanin martaba fayil ɗaya ne a Google Drive ɗinku: {file}, a cikin babban fayil {folder}. Ku sauke ko ku kwafe shi a can; hirar za ta iya ba ku mahaɗinsa.
data.export_file: Duk bayanin martaba fayil ɗaya ne a Google Drive ɗinku: {file}. Ku sauke ko ku kwafe shi a can; hirar za ta iya ba ku mahaɗinsa.
data.others: Wasu fayilolin da ke da bayanin martaba: {files}. MathTrail yana karanta mafi sabo kawai; kuna iya share sauran.
data.delete_how: Ku share fayil ɗin, sannan ku zubar da Kwandon shara na Drive: babu wani abu na bayanin martaba da zai rage a ko'ina.
data.access_how: A Asusun Google ɗinku, a cikin manhajojin ɓangare na uku masu damar shiga, ku cire MathTrail: daga nan ba zai iya kai wa ga komai ba.
data.remove_how: Ku cire haɗin MathTrail a cikin saitunan manhajar hirarku.
first_run.label: Barka da zuwa MathTrail
first_run.lead: MathTrail yana ba yara tambayoyin lissafi irin na gasa don aji 1 zuwa 6, a nan cikin hirar, kuma yana bayani kan kowane kuskure. Babba ke saita shi: ɗaya daga cikin iyaye ko mai koyarwa.
first_run.pseudonym: Ana sanin mai koyo da sunan laƙabi kawai: kada ku taɓa rubuta ainihin suna, ranar haihuwa ko makaranta.
first_run.fill_label: Abin da hirar za ta tambaya
first_run.fill: Sunan laƙabi da aji, daga 1 zuwa 6. Idan kuna so, har da abubuwan sha'awar mai koyo, abin da ba a koya a makaranta ba tukuna, da harshen darussa.
first_run.data: A cikin fayil ɗaya a Google Drive ɗinku na kanku, wanda kuke iya buɗewa, saukewa ko sharewa. MathTrail ba ya ajiye komai a ɓangarensa.
first_run.start: Ku nemi bayanin martaba na MathTrail a cikin wannan hirar, sannan ku amsa abin da ta tambaya. Kuna iya canza shi daga baya, a “Bayanin martaba da ci gaba”.
first_run.not_created: Ba a ƙirƙiri bayanin martaba ba.
card.unreadable: Ba za a iya nuna wannan katin a nan ba. Hirar ta faɗi abu ɗaya da kalmomi.

advice.off_by_one: Kafin a amsa, a yi ɗan zane da sauri: turaku a matsayin ɗigo da tazarar da ke tsakaninsu, sannan a ƙidaya duka biyun.
advice.missed_case: A rubuta yanayoyi bisa tsayayyen tsari, daga mafi ƙanƙanta, a kuma yi wa kowanne alama don kada wani ya tsallake.
advice.double_count: A rubuta kowane zaɓi sau ɗaya, bisa tsayayyen tsari, a kuma nemi maimaici kafin a ƙidaya su.
advice.ignored_not: A karanta tambayar da ƙarfi, a zagaye kalmar “ba” kafin a warware ta.
advice.answered_other_question: Kafin a amsa, a faɗi da kalmomin kai abin da tambayar ke nema, sannan a duba amsar da shi.
advice.stopped_early: Bayan kowane taki, a tambayi ko abin da tambayar ke so ke nan, ko kuwa taki ne kawai zuwa gare shi.
advice.wrong_operation: A kwaikwayi labarin da ƙananan abubuwa ko zane, don a ga ko ana ƙarawa, ana ragewa ko ana rabawa.
advice.reversed_relation: A zana kwatancen a kan layi daga mafi ƙanƙanta zuwa mafi girma kafin a karanta amsar.
advice.best_case_not_worst: A tambayi yadda abubuwa za su iya faruwa da mafi rashin sa'a, a kuma tabbatar amsar ta tsaya ko a lokacin.
advice.trusted_statement: Ga kowace magana, a gwada duka biyun: me zai biyo baya idan gaskiya ce, da me zai biyo baya idan ƙarya ce.
advice.time_unit_mixup: A zana fuskar agogo a ƙidaya gaba da minti, ana tuna cewa sa'a guda tana da minti 60, ba 100 ba.
advice.number_from_text: Kafin a rubuta lamba, a faɗi daga wane lissafi ta fito: lambar da aka kwafo daga tambaya ba kasafai take zama amsa ba.
advice.wrong_parity: A fara duba rabuwa da biyu a kan ƙananan lambobi, kamar 1 + 3 da 3 + 5, sannan a faɗi ƙa'idar da ƙarfi.
advice.ignored_condition: A sake karanta tambayar a yi alama a kan kowane sharaɗi, kamar “daban-daban” ko “sau ɗaya kacal”, sannan a duba amsar da kowanne.
advice.percent_wrong_base: A fara tambaya: kashi na me? A rubuta wannan cikakken adadin kafin a ɗauki kashin.
advice.part_whole_swap: A zana cikakken abu a matsayin doguwar sanda a shafa launi a sashen, sannan a duba wanne daga cikin biyun tambayar ke nema.
advice.ratio_total_confusion: A zana gwargwadon a matsayin akwatuna iri ɗaya, a ƙidaya dukkan akwatunan don jimla, sannan a nemo abin da akwati ɗaya ke ɗauka.
advice.remainder_vs_quotient: A raba abubuwa na gaske zuwa ƙungiyoyi, sannan a faɗi da ƙarfi wace lamba ce ƙungiyoyin, wace kuma ce saura.
advice.area_perimeter_swap: A bi gefen da yatsa don kewaye, a shafa launi a ciki don fili, sannan a sake karanta wanne ake tambaya.
advice.first_move_assumed: A buga wasan sau kaɗan daga ƙananan matsayi, a ga wa ke cin kowanne, kafin a yanke shawara.
